description: This file defines a service for calculating total costs associated with language model agents. It provides functions to resolve collection candidates, build aggregation pipelines for different schemas, perform database aggregation, and a fallback in-process aggregation. The main function 'getLlmCostByAgent' attempts to retrieve and aggregate cost data from a MongoDB collection with support for multiple schemas and field configurations. It enables cost analysis by agent, supporting environments with different data structures.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines collection names based on environment variable and default list, deduplicating while preserving order.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with various agent and cost fields, normalizing agent names and summing costs in USD, with sorting.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a pipeline to process documents where agents and costs are stored in an array of objects, normalizing agent names and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation over a list of documents with an 'Agents' array, normalizing agent names and summing costs to produce sorted results.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main async function that attempts to aggregate cost data at the database level via multiple pipelines; if they fail, falls back to in-process aggregation. Returns array of agents with total costs.
